scope: These figures describe the {n_total} loans of the mature {test_years} test window ({term}-month term, at least 90% resolved), not the full {n_rows} resolved loans.

sheets.title: Observed default
sheets.headline: {default_rate_total}
sheets.headline_label: of resolved loans ended in default
sheets.computation: We divide {observed_defaults} defaults by {n_total} resolved loans. The Wilson 95% CI is {ci_low} to {ci_high}.
sheets.reading: About {defaults_per_100} of every 100 loans ended in default.
sheets.caveat: Right-censoring is why only mature loans are measured.

sheets.title: Predicted PD
sheets.headline: {mean_pd}
sheets.computation: The {champion} model's average predicted PD over the same loans; out-of-time AUC is {champion_auc}.
sheets.reading: Observed is {gap_pp} pp above predicted, so the model underestimates risk on average. Calibration details are in Evidence.
sheets.visual_note: Fill = observed; outline = predicted. Observed minus predicted: +{gap_pp} pp

sheets.title: Expected loss
sheets.headline: {el_pct_ead} of EAD
sheets.headline_label: expected loss on EAD at default
sheets.computation: EL is {el_amount} on {ead_total} of EAD. The funded amount is {funded_total}; EL is {el_pct_funded} of funded. LGD is {mean_lgd_pct}.
sheets.reading: EL = PD × LGD × EAD, where EAD is funded amount × the train grade EAD rate; about ${el_per_100} per $100 of EAD.
sheets.caveat: EAD at default is estimated on train defaults, not assumed equal to the full funded amount.
